metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.program: Hawaii Department of Health — Genetics Division — Newborn Metabolic Screening Program
metabolic_screening.opt_out_form_label: Newborn Metabolic Screening Test Refusal Form (page 32 of the Hawaii Newborn Screening Practitioner's Manual)
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: Hawaii requires a signed Newborn Metabolic Screening Test Refusal (informed dissent) form. The form is in the Hawaii NBS Practitioner's Manual (page 32); parents sign and the form is placed in the infant's medical record with copies forwarded to the Hawaii Newborn Screening Program and the primary care provider. No standalone state PDF is hosted separately.
metabolic_screening.statute: Hawaii Revised Statutes 327-88 (newborn screening); Hawaii Administrative Rules 11-400
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Collect blood spot per protocol; if parent declines on religious/personal grounds, obtain signed refusal form from the Practitioner's Manual, place in medical record, and forward to the NHSP.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening (EHDI)
hearing_screening.program: Hawaii Department of Health — Children with Special Health Needs Branch — Newborn Hearing Screening Program (NHSP)
hearing_screening.opt_out_form_label: Newborn Metabolic Screening Test Refusal Form (covers hearing component)
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Same refusal form covers hearing screening refusal. Hawaii's newborn screening program includes metabolic and hearing screening components.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if objection, obtain signed refusal form per Practitioner's Manual, document in medical record, and forward to NHSP.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.program: Hawaii Department of Health — Newborn Screening Program
cchd_screening.state_form_note: CCHD screening refusal documented via the same informed dissent process as metabolic screening. No separate CCHD declination form.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse oximetry screening; if out-of-hospital birth, coordinate with receiving facility or regional provider for CCHD screen before discharge.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.program: Hawaii law — not part of the NBS program
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: No standalone state declination form for eye prophylaxis; documented via medical record refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If declining: document refusal in medical record. If administering: apply ophthalmic prophylaxis within 1—2 hours of birth per standard protocol.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in medical record; midwife administers injection if chosen.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.program: Hawaii Department of Health — Immunization Program
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; report to the Hawaii Immunization Registry (HIR).

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal/intrapartum)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; GBS swab in late pregnancy; intrapartum antibiotics arranged via referral or in-office for out-of-hospital births when indicated.

program_contact.name: Hawaii Department of Health — Newborn Metabolic Screening Program
